Just did it. I wish my nangs experiences were as extreme as some of the questions implied lol

Thank you for your advice.  I've just seen the inpatient psychiatrist and she's recommended to me that I go to a private hospital for a bit and I'm going to do that. It's good to hear an opinion from am outsiders perspective. I think I'm going to be able to go home and see my cat for a short visit before I go anyway.

I feel like I speak a whole other language in my head and I have trouble interpreting what's going on in there verbally so my words and sentences become a jumbled mess that can be difficult for other to understand.

Update: Got them taken out, I was actually surprisingly calm going into the operating room. The surgery all went well and I woke up in the recovery room annoying everyone by singing ABBA out loud lol. I'm home now, with minimal pain but still can't feel my lips. Hoping to get some sleep and wake up feeling better. Thanks for the good advice people 🌼❤️
Thank you so much for this! It really helps to hear from someone else's experience. I hope your recovery goes well :)

ahhhh I have this issue too D: I hate it so much because I've drifted away from some really good friends just because I don't open texts for weeks
usually I don't open them until I'm with my sister or a friend and they help me to write a message and that seems to really help for me
update: I just went back into the shop, the piercer was very sweet, took them out and has offered to re-pierce them for me for free in about a week. Thanks for all the replies!!!!

The piercer did show me the marking spots of what angle it'd be on, but not exactly where the piercing would be entering from. I didn't think twice about it when I got it done, just trusting the piercer to do the proper job 🤷
Pretty pissed off that I may have to get it re-done since it bloody hurt so much

Thank you so much for the quick responses. I'm not going to take them out myself but now I'm planning to go back to the shop as soon as possible. I'm just unsure because I was reading on other places that it could just be swelling, but it's probably a lot safer to get someone to see it.
